jobs.description:
Role Description 
 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical planning, partnering with Windows, macOS, and Linux engineers to introduce changes safely across a distributed environment. You will develop automation, integrations, and configuration-as-code workflows, validate platform capabilities, and guide phased adoption. Beyond migration, you will improve platform reliability, visibility, and maintainability, helping the team reduce manual work and operate the service with shared ownership. You will partner with Security, IAM, CorpInfra, and support teams to resolve dependencies and make practical trade-offs. This is an individual-contributor position with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities. 
 Responsibilities 
 
  Lead the FleetDM migration.  Define scope, requirements, architecture, dependencies, and a phased delivery plan with OS specialists and partner teams. 
  Engineer and operate the shared platform.  Maintain configuration, agent workflows, policies, queries, integrations, and operational automation. 
  Make deployment safe and repeatable.  Build version-controlled configuration with automated checks, peer review, controlled rollout, drift detection, and recovery. 
  Validate capabilities and coexistence.  Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools. 
  Make platform health actionable.  Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows. 
  Protect service continuity.  Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions. 
  Strengthen team capability.  Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs. 
  Improve efficiency and cost.  Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries. 
 Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover. 
 Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience. 
 Demonstrated use of Git, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for configuration or infrastructure changes. 
 Ability to diagnose enrollment, agent, policy, identity, networking, and integration failures and distinguish missing data from healthy devices. 
 Experience establishing monitoring, failure handling, least-privilege access, secrets management, and maintainable operational workflows. 
 Ability to independently define priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders, communicate trade-offs, and mentor engineers. 
 Clear written and verbal communication and effective asynchronous collaboration across regions. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Production experience with FleetDM configuration, policies, queries, APIs, agent operations, or deployment automation. 
 Practical osquery and SQL experience, including query validation, performance considerations, targeting, and stale or missing results. 
 Migration or coexistence experience involving Intune, Jamf, or comparable endpoint-management platforms. 
 Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity, security, inventory, or ITSM services. 
 Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments. 
 Demonstrated improvements in platform operating effort, tool consolidation, or lifecycle cost.

jobs.title: [Job-32674] Senior Software Developer (.NET / Azure), Brazil
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.  With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.  We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.  We’re looking for a  Senior Software Developer  to join a dedicated nearshore team building a placement management platform for a US education client. The platform runs on Azure with .NET Core APIs, a React frontend and a Dynamics 365 / Dataverse CRM core. You’ll design and build the secure backend services that connect them.  What you’ll do  
 Build and maintain C# / .NET Core APIs as microservices hosted on Azure (App Service, Functions, API Management). 
 Implement web authentication and authorization flows, including JWT-based token handling and SSO with SAML and OpenID Connect. 
 Integrate APIs with Dynamics 365 / Dataverse and the React frontend. 
 Work in Azure DevOps (repos, pipelines, boards) within an Agile team, overlapping with US Central Time. 
  What we’re looking for  
 Proven experience with backend development in C# / .NET, with production experience on Azure. 
 Hands-on experience implementing authentication: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT, and SSO / SAML. 
 Experience designing RESTful microservices, including security, logging and error handling. 
 Upper-intermediate or advanced English for daily communication with US stakeholders. 
  Nice to have  
 Microsoft Entra ID or Entra External ID (formerly Azure AD B2C). 
 Dataverse Web API or Dynamics 365 integration. 
 Azure certifications such as AZ-204. 
  Our benefits:  -Health and dental insurance  -Meal and food allowance  -Childcare assistance  -Extended paternity leave  -Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;  -Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);  -Life insurance  -Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);  -Discount club  -Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being  -Pregnancy and responsible parenting course  -Partnerships with online learning platforms  -Language learning platform  And many more!  More details about our benefits here:   At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important  to present your assessment during the selection process.   See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here .This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve.  If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it. 
  We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.  Originally posted on  Himalayas
